user.title: Add Scheduler+
user.description: Scheduler+ is a visual scheduling engine for lights and climate devices. Individual schedules are created afterwards from the Scheduler+ dashboard.

init.title: Default scheduling preferences
init.description: The fallback used by the rule editor's quick-fill presets (Weekdays, Weekend, After hours) for anyone who hasn't set their own under My Preferences on the Scheduler+ card. This does not override a user's own choice.

data.enable_brightness: Allow brightness control in light rules
data.enable_fade_in: Allow fade-in transitions in light rules

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Turns a Scheduler+ operating mode on or off for a single date, or releases that date back to the mode's weekly repeat.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: The name of the mode, as shown on the Scheduler+ dashboard.

state.name: State
state.description: On or Off pins the date; 'Follow the weekly repeat' removes a previously pinned date.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date to change. Defaults to today. A schedule is gated by the date its window starts on, so an event running past midnight belongs to the date it began.
